facts.fact: The TerraPay press release says Orange Finances Money Mali is an e-money institution licensed by the Central Bank of West African States (BCEAO), founded in 2015.

Orange Finances Money Mali and TerraPay say Orange Money Mali customers can now receive money transfers from several countries into their wallets through TerraPay's direct connection and global network.

MLI.note: No government payments to people are mentioned.

facts.fact: The TerraPay press release says Orange Finances Money Mali, an Orange Mali subsidiary, is an e-money institution authorised by the Central Bank of West African States and issues e-money under the Orange Money brand.

MLI.note: The 12 million figure is a customer count, not a survey of adults.

facts.fact: The press release says Orange Money wallets in Mali can be used for bill payments, supermarket purchases and person-to-person transfers, and calls Orange Finances Money Mali the country's largest mobile payment operator.

MLI.note: No tax or fee payment is mentioned.
